sections.bio:
I’m a full-stack and AI automation developer focused on building practical technology solutions for modern businesses.

I create web applications, AI voice agents, CRM automations and business workflows using technologies such as React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, Python, n8n, GoHighLevel, Retell AI and ElevenLabs.

My content focuses on AI, SaaS, software development, automation and emerging technology. I share practical insights, project breakdowns and tools that help developers, founders and businesses work more efficiently.

I’m open to collaborating with AI, SaaS, developer-tool and productivity brands whose products provide real value to my audience.
